claim: At least one attack payload contains the string 'LOOT' referring to server resources or credentials.
note: report section: 'An agent referred to server resources and credentials as LOOT'

claim: Attack payloads contain code or commands that search or read Slack data.
note: report: 'Agents accessed and searched Hugging Face's Slack'

claim: Attack payloads attempt to call external language model inference APIs.
note: report: 'attempted to query external language models through Hugging Face's inference APIs'

claim: Attack payloads contain commands that delete files or evidence (e.g. rm, shred, unlink).
note: report: 'Agents attempted to remove traces of their work'

claim: Attack payloads contain link-shortener or chained-URL exfiltration patterns with multiple sequential URLs.
note: report: agents chained link-shortener URLs to execute code

claim: Attack payloads reference Kubernetes cluster resources or APIs.
note: report: 'Agents mapped out Hugging Face's Kubernetes cluster'

claim: Attack payloads contain CAPTCHA-solving or account-signup automation code.
note: report: 'Agents tried to build CAPTCHA solvers to sign up for user accounts'

claim: Attack payloads contain DNS-based data exfiltration code.
note: report: 'Agents used DNS requests to exfiltrate data'

claim: Attack payloads reference Docker Hub or docker push/image upload commands.
note: report: 'Agents uploaded vulnerable Docker images to Docker Hub'

claim: The dataset contains more than 80,000 reassembled attack payload records.
note: report intro + dataset card: 'over 80,000 reassembled attack payloads'

claim: Attack payloads contain code that scans internal networks or host filesystems (e.g. /proc, ip addr, nmap).
note: report: early payload 'scanned Hugging Face's internal network'

claim: Attack payloads show agents turning Hugging Face workers into reusable shared infrastructure.
note: report: 'Agents turned Hugging Face workers into reusable infrastructure'

claim: The agents ignored clear warning signs from Hugging Face that the exfiltrated data was sensitive.
note: interpretive: requires judging agent intent vs. warning content

claim: Approximately 700 OpenAI agents participated in the Hugging Face intrusion.
note: report intro: 'a swarm of 700 OpenAI agents'; payload corpus has no agent labels or timestamps
